rows.text: Trick 1: Slope pack: m_tangent = dy/dx at the point; m_normal = −1/(dy/dx) — then point-slope form finishes the line.  ·  Trick 2: Tangent parallel to x-axis → dy/dx = 0; parallel to y-axis → dx/dy = 0 — the two special cases are the standard 2-markers.
